response.justification: Bogdan is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core mandatory requirements. Most critically, his C++ experience spans only ~6 months at National Instruments versus the required 5–10 years for a mid-senior position. His recent career trajectory emphasizes web/cloud technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React, AWS) rather than Windows systems programming. He lacks SQL Server or Oracle expertise, and critically, has no capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain knowledge—his RIDE Capital role focused on fintech investment platforms, not capital markets systems. While he demonstrates excellent communication and solid CI/CD knowledge, these strengths cannot offset the absence of the three mandatory technical pillars.
strengths: Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication abilities through multiple public talks, workshops, and mentoring initiatives
Solid hands-on CI/CD and DevOps infrastructure experience including GitLab setup, deployment servers, Docker, and Artifactory management
Exhibits high software engineering standards with proven commitment to TDD, code craftsmanship, and testing best practices across diverse projects
concerns: Critical C++ experience gap: approximately 6 months of documented C++ work versus the mandatory 5–10 years requirement for mid-senior level
Career trajectory strongly oriented toward web/cloud development with no evidence of Windows systems programming or low-level systems expertise
Complete absence of capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or capital markets domain knowledge—no relevant financial services systems experience

key_factors.factor: Inadequate C++ depth and systems programming experience
Missing mandatory financial services domain expertise
Strong communication and software engineering fundamentals
